name: desktop
description: PageSpace Desktop - Native desktop app for PageSpace

scripts.package:mac: bun run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.pagespace.json --mac --publish never
scripts.package:win: bun run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.pagespace.json --win --publish never
scripts.package:linux: bun run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.pagespace.json --linux --publish never
scripts.package:coder: bun run build:coder && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.coder.json --publish never
scripts.package:coder:mac: bun run build:coder && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.coder.json --mac --publish never
scripts.package:coder:win: bun run build:coder && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.coder.json --win --publish never
scripts.package:coder:linux: bun run build:coder && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.coder.json --linux --publish never
